title: ServiceAccount
description: A credential for CI that is not a person. It is named after the organisation, as <organisation>:<metadata.name>, has no email address and cannot sign in. It holds the member role unless spec.role says admin or owner. A member cannot invite people, mint further credentials or change policy; an admin or owner service account can, so it is the credential to give Terraform or CI that applies Platform IaC. Applying a new ServiceAccount creates it and returns its API key and secret once, in the apply result's status (status.apiKey and status.secret): they are never shown again, by plan, export or the console, so store them as the apply returns them. Applying needs an owner or admin. Deleting the document deactivates the service account, so its key stops working; it is kept for the audit trail, and its name cannot be used again.

metadata.description: The name is 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, such as ci-scanner.

spec.description: A service account declares its name and, optionally, its role.

role.description: member, admin or owner. member (the default) can scan and read but cannot change policy. admin and owner can apply Platform IaC, so give Terraform or CI one of those. The role cannot be higher than the role of whoever applies the document, and only an owner may grant owner.
